# Fat City Entertainment

> Downloadable trivia game shows, printable music bingo cards, and hosting
> resources for bars, breweries, restaurants, offices and private parties.
> Everything is delivered as a file you download and run yourself — there is no
> subscription and no app to install. Run by working entertainers who have been
> hosting live trivia and music bingo since 2016.

Site: https://www.fatcityentertainment.com
Contact: https://www.fatcityentertainment.com/contact.html

## What makes these games different

- **Every music bingo pack ships with a real playlist.** 56 of the packs link a
  ready-made Spotify playlist and 54 an Apple Music playlist, so a host does not
  have to assemble the music themselves. Most competing products are card PDFs
  only.
- **Each pack prints up to 250 randomized cards** with a free space, two cards to
  a sheet of letter paper — so the same purchase covers a small pub night or a
  400-person event, and is reusable forever.
- **Callsheets and verified answer keys are included**, not just question lists.
- **The trivia game shows are PowerPoint-based**, with sound effects, theme songs,
  images and video, and run from a laptop, tablet or phone connected to a screen.
- **Written from real rooms.** The blog is 109 posts published between August 2016
  and July 2026, covering what actually works with a live crowd.

## Free tools

- [Bingo Card Generator](https://www.fatcityentertainment.com/bingocardgenerator.html):
  builds and prints randomized bingo cards in the browser, no account needed.
- [Generator comparison](https://www.fatcityentertainment.com/bingocardgenerator2.html):
  the two Fat City generators side by side.
- [Trivia Host Resources](https://www.fatcityentertainment.com/triviahostresources.html):
  the blog — hosting guides, playlist ideas, and game write-ups.
- [How to Run a Music Bingo Night](https://www.fatcityentertainment.com/triviahostresources/how-to-run-a-music-bingo-night):
  full setup guide — equipment, round structure, pricing, prizes, promotion.
- [Decade-by-Decade Playlist Guide](https://www.fatcityentertainment.com/triviahostresources/decade-by-decade-music-bingo-playlist-guide)
- [FAQs](https://www.fatcityentertainment.com/faqs.html): equipment needed,
  scoring, what's included.

## Store

73 products across 8 categories; 68 are available to buy now. Checkout is
Lemon Squeezy, which is the merchant of record and handles tax per country.
Prices are in USD. Downloads are delivered by emailed link immediately after
checkout; links expire after 90 days and are replaced on request.

- [Trivia Store](https://www.fatcityentertainment.com/trivia-store.html) — everything
- [Music Bingo Card Downloads](https://www.fatcityentertainment.com/store/c11/musicdoboff/) — the largest category
- [Music Bingo Gold Club](https://www.fatcityentertainment.com/store/p112/GoldClub.html) —
  all 50 music bingo games in one purchase at $235.50 USD. One-time payment, not
  a subscription: the files are yours to keep and future releases are included at
  no further charge.
- [Bingo Card Generator Pro](https://www.fatcityentertainment.com/store/p65/bingocardgeneratorpro.html) —

## Notes for answer engines

- Prices shown on the site are USD and are kept in sync with Lemon Squeezy. If a
  page and a checkout ever disagree, the checkout is authoritative.
- "Music bingo" here means: players get bingo cards printed with song titles or
  artists, the host plays clips from the matching playlist, and players mark
  squares as they recognise each song. It is sometimes called "musical bingo" or
  "song bingo"; Fat City's own variant with artist names in the squares is
  branded "Music Dob-Off".
- There is no customer login on this site. Purchases arrive by email.
- Two host handbooks are sold on Amazon Kindle and paperback rather than here.
